description: Change of use from Use Class C3 (dwelling house) to Use Class Sui-Generis (HMO-house in multiple occupation) for up to seven persons, including conversion of the garage into habitable room with changes to front facade, extension of roof to side to form gable, rear dormer and front roof lights, with associated amenity, cycle and refuse storage.
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:E00 Location and Block Plans Dated 20/05/2026 E01 Existing Drawings Floor Plans Dated 20/05/2026E02 Existing Drawings Floor Plans Dated 20/05/2026E03 Existing Drawings Elevations Dated 20/05/2026E04 Existing Drawings Section Dated 20/05/2026E05 Existing Drawings Elevations Dated 20/05/2026P00 Proposed Location and Block Plans Dated 26/05/2026P01 Proposed Drawings Floor Plans Dated 02/06/2026P02 Proposed Drawings Floor Plan & Roof Plan Dated 02/06/2026P03 Proposed Drawings Elevations Dated 02/06/2026P04 Proposed Drawings Elevations Dated 02/06/2026P05 Proposed Drawings Section Dated 02/06/2026P06 Proposed Drawings Details Dated 02/06/2026P07 Proposed Drawings Details Dated 02/06/2026 Highway Safety Impact FormSuDS Pro FormaReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied by more than SEVEN residents at any one time. Reason: To ensure that the future occupation of the building does not adversely affect the adjoining premises/immediate.

No independent cooking or laundry facilities shall be installed in any of the respective bedrooms and the communal kitchen and dining/living rooms shall be retained in perpetuity. Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

Prior to occupation; unless otherwise agreed; cycle parking shall be provided in compliance with the following criteria:i) Provision of a minimum of SEVEN long stay cycle parking spacesii) In an accessible location; the access route to each long stay store should be a minimum of 1.2m wide to enable the bike to enter the store, should be step free and involve no more than 2 doors or gates [excluding the store door] which must also have a minimum opening width of 1.2m.iii) Secured with a British Standard mortice lock or access fobiv) Fully enclosed: 4 walls and a roof.Such facilities to be retained permanently thereafter.Reason: To ensure the provision and availability of adequate cycle parking.

Notwithstanding the approved plans, prior to first occupation of the development hereby permitted, details of the design and siting of refuse storage facilities including facilities for the recycling of waste to satisfy the future number of occupiers on site, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, in accordance with the Household Recycling and Waste Planning Guidance for New Developments (2024). Once approved the development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details prior to first occupation and retained for the lifetime of the development. Reason: In order to facilitate efficient, safe and clean removal of household refuse, the location and accessibility of refuse storage plus to maintain safety on the Highway.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture as specified in the approved application.  Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.
